features.statement: Social links appear as plain text labels with no icon graphics.
Hero headline mixes light-weight dark text with bold accent-colored words.
Deep heading outline: many h2/h3/h4 used for product names, collections and footer columns.
Uses semantic sectioning elements (nav, section, article) to structure content.
Includes a meta description and minimal, clean metadata and script-free markup.
Header has three tiers: colored announcement bar, utility bar with contact and social links, main nav row.
Small letter-spaced uppercase eyebrow label sits above the main headline.
Hero uses a soft pale gradient background with decorative translucent ring shapes.
Cohesive branded teal/green palette with dark green-tinted text and mint tints.
Buttons are fully rounded pills in filled, outlined and white variants.
Icon-led category cards presented in an equal-width row of bordered rounded cards.
Photography is used on collection cards, with product lists beneath each photo.
Full-width two-column gradient feature band with light heading, vertical divider and white CTA.
Value propositions are shown as a three-column row of centered bordered cards, each with a pill CTA.
Newsletter signup is a rounded input with inline white pill button on a dark colored band.
Footer is a dark multi-column section with white headings and light muted link text.
Payment logos are shown in a horizontal centered row of small badges.
Relaxed body line-height of about 1.6.
Cards use rounded corners and thin pale borders instead of box shadows.
Many hover/transition effects and a translucent blurred sticky header.
Section backgrounds alternate between white, mint and dark teal bands to separate content.
Section headings and intro paragraphs are centered in a narrower text column.
Sans-serif Helvetica Neue/Arial font stack, with large light-weight display headline.
Section headings are mid-size at regular weight rather than bold.
Prices are shown in bold accent color with 'from $' prefix for variable pricing.
All images carry descriptive alt text.
Centered content container of roughly 1120px using CSS grid and flexbox layouts.
Marketing-style copy with taglines, subheads, and calls like 'Sign Up and Save' and shipping announcements.
Small hand-written class vocabulary rather than utility-style classes.
